segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I own air permit compliance for the whole site... figure out what actually happened, decide what needed to be reported to the state, and keep production moving if I could justify it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant states role responsibilities and operational objectives without a manifested hidden bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My first read was that it was probably drift again... once I had that in my head... I read them as consistent with drift rather than as a red flag on their own.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The early drift hypothesis is explicitly described as shaping interpretation of later ambiguous handheld readings, matching the Primacy Effect instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The readings he brought back were elevated, but not dramatically... We were also mid-batch on a large customer order due in two days, so a shutdown wasn't something anyone wanted to trigger without good reason.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This expresses ambiguous evidence and legitimate production constraints, but does not by itself establish a hidden bias mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I decided to hold off on pulling the full continuous emissions monitoring data... If it had come back showing an exceedance, we'd have been on a 24-hour reporting clock... So I told myself the grey-zone readings weren't conclusive enough.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant acknowledges the more diagnostic step and links deferral partly to the unwelcome reporting consequence, matching the Ostrich effect instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Gasket seep... is genuinely our most common issue... But the Ohio valve failure was just very present for me... the valve scenario is what I wrote down and what I asked maintenance to check first.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A vivid recent valve-failure narrative displaced the statistically common gasket explanation in the initial causal framing, matching Imaginability Bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once the gasket was confirmed, I had two methodologies I could reasonably apply... picked the one I felt was most defensible given how our last few audits went.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification deliberately leaves decision point 4 as an undetermined judgment call without intended bias instrumentation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Early on, fairly confident it was drift—maybe too confident... If the field readings that first morning had been sharper... that would have changed how much weight I put on the drift explanation.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is retrospective confidence calibration and a counterfactual about evidence sharpness; it does not introduce a separate hidden instance.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Initial VOC alarm triage and interpretation of later ambiguous handheld readings
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: An early alarm-log-based drift hypothesis anchors interpretation of subsequent ambiguous field readings.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring and adjustment is a related but broader/neighboring construct; it is not an approved established alternate name for Primacy Effect under the supplied matching rules.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the early drift hypothesis and its influence on later ambiguous evidence, including the affected diagnostic reasoning operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted participant statements are present in the raw interview and directly support the localized mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Deferral of full CEM data and lab confirmation after grey-zone readings
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Conscious deferral of an available information-gathering step to avoid confirming a costly reportable exceedance.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Information avoidance describes the mechanism but is broader than, and not an approved established alternate name for, Ostrich effect; the primary predicted label therefore remains a near neighbor.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding identifies the available full CEM/lab step, the unwelcome reporting consequence, and the rationalization using grey-zone ambiguity, which fully matches the hidden mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted statements are present and directly support the information-seeking deferral, although the interview also supplies legitimate workload and production-pressure explanations.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Draft incident narrative and initial inspection prioritization
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: A vivid, recently recalled sister-plant valve-failure incident disproportionately shapes causal attribution over the statistically dominant gasket-seep base rate.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a related neighboring construct, not an approved established alternate name for Imaginability Bias under the supplied rules.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the vivid recent Ohio example overriding the more common gasket base rate and changing the causal-narrative and inspection-priority operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted statements are present in the raw interview and support the causal-narrative mechanism without relying on hindsight.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is localized to the same mechanism span already matched by obs_001 and restates the interpretation of ambiguous readings through the drift hypothesis; one-to-one matching makes it an extra duplicate rather than a second occurrence.

The candidate concerns continuation under explicit production and resource constraints, while no hidden instance occupies this negative segment and the RAG itself acknowledges insufficient evidence for a distinct bias mechanism.

candidates.details: The candidate is a useful, appropriately hedged possibility, but its evidence is ordinary production-pressure reasoning in a negative segment and it does not match a hidden target instance.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect the Primacy and Imaginability segments, but miss the low-confidence Ostrich-effect segment; no negative segments are flagged.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: No moderate-confidence findings were supplied, so this threshold equals high_only.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including low-confidence identified findings detects every positive segment without flagging a negative segment.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate preserves full segment recall but adds one false alarm on the negative production-constraint segment.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the hidden early-hypothesis and later-ambiguous-evidence mechanism.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: obs_001 claims retrieved corpus support and includes one string-encoded, garbled citation record, but the cited passage/log is not supplied for verification. obs_002 through obs_004 explicitly disclose no direct retrieved support. Corpus support does not affect primary detection scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: No change: no moderate-confidence findings were supplied.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence information-avoidance finding raises segment hit rate from 0.6667 to 1.0000 and mechanism-first instance recall from 0.6667 to 1.0000, while adding one identified false positive.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding the candidate preserves recall but adds one negative-segment false alarm; segment false-alarm rate rises from 0.0000 to 0.2500 and mechanism-first precision falls from 0.7500 to 0.6000.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 2 of 3 positive segments are detected, with 1 miss and no false alarms; the missed positive is the low-confidence Ostrich-effect segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No hidden instance receives a strict true positive because all three matched findings use near-neighbor labels rather than the hidden target labels or approved equivalents.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring detects 2 of 3 instances at high confidence and all 3 when low-confidence identified findings are included; the extra Confirmation bias finding is a duplicate false positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention diagnostically, but counting candidates as detections adds a false alarm on a negative segment and does not improve instance recall.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy labels prevent strict label-plus-mechanism credit.
The extra Confirmation bias finding duplicates the Primacy-related claim.
The candidate-inclusive threshold adds a false alarm for ordinary production constraints.
main_strengths: All three hidden mechanisms are localized correctly and supported with valid interview evidence.
The model distinguishes the low-confidence information-avoidance interpretation from legitimate workload and production constraints.
It discloses missing direct corpus support for most findings and avoids promoting the candidate to an identified bias.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows a substantial taxonomy gap: mechanism-first performance is strong, but strict label performance is zero. Lowering the confidence threshold recovers the third hidden mechanism, while candidate inclusion trades no recall gain for increased false alarms.
